title: TractionCurrentGuardedThresholdV2
description: Reassessed guarded threshold for electrical traction de-energization derived from the corrected GUM uncertainty budget, invalidating the legacy 0.413 A RMS value.

legacy_threshold_audit.rationale: The legacy threshold 0.413 A RMS was derived from an unverified U = 0.087 A (0.500 - 0.087 = 0.413). However, recomputation of the seven component standard uncertainties yields u_c = 0.04520 A and U = 0.0904 A. Under GUM and ISO 14253-1, preserving 0.413 A is inadmissible.

corrected_threshold_derivation.decision_rule_standard: ISO 14253-1:2017 Clause 8 / ILAC G8:09/2019 Binary Guarded Decision Rule
corrected_threshold_derivation.derivation_formula: I_guarded = I_nominal - U = 0.500 A - 0.0904 A = 0.4096 A RMS

instrument_chain_dependency.dependency_note: While the numerical derivation of 0.410 A RMS is mathematically exact from the component model, the input component U1_CAL_PROBE assumes a verified 0.1 V/A or 0.2 V/A transfer ratio. Because the TCPA300 amplifier does not support 10 A/V with a TCP303 probe, the guarded threshold cannot be certified for physical capture until physical calibration on the 5 A/V (0.2 V/A) range is completed on the bench.
